name: Hall of Legends
summary: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength, Horde champions gather in the Hall of Legends. Behind its guarded entrance, proven officers confer over battle plans and arm themselves with weapons and armor from conflicts across Azeroth and beyond.

sections.title: Sanctuary of Horde Champions
sections.body: Horde officers gather in the Hall of Legends, off the Valley of Strength's busy avenues. Beyond its guarded entrance, strategists and delegates from across the faction confer over maps of contested lands and the military standing of both factions. Among them are Chieftain Earthbind of Thunder Bluff, Blood Guard Hini'wana of the Darkspear, and Advisor Willington of the Undercity. Only warriors who have reached the rank of Stone Guard or higher may enter and claim the arms and spoils kept within.

sections.title: The Spoils of War
sections.body: The Hall of Legends holds armories stocked with battle-tested wargear for proven Horde officers. For those rising through the military ranks, its weapons and armor mark honor, martial skill, and victory hard won.

faq.q: Who is allowed inside the Hall of Legends?
aliases: can i enter hall of legends
rank required for hall of legends
faq.answer: Only Horde champions who have reached the rank of Stone Guard or higher may enter the Hall of Legends. Lower-ranking soldiers and ordinary citizens are turned away at the entrance.

faq.q: Where is the Hall of Legends located?
aliases: how to get to hall of legends
faq.answer: The Hall of Legends stands in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar, near the city's primary barracks and administrative seat.

faq.q: What is inside the Hall of Legends?
aliases: what is in hall of legends
faq.answer: Inside, a central strategy table is flanked by military representatives of the Horde's various races, with maps of Azeroth and military records around them. Quartermasters maintain armories here and distribute prestigious arms, armor, and mounts to accomplished officers.

faq.q: Does the Alliance have an equivalent location?
faq.answer: Yes. The Alliance counterpart is the Champions' Hall in Stormwind City's Old Town district, an officer barracks and armory for honored Alliance combatants.

angles.text: For the Horde, the Hall of Legends recognizes military achievement and offers strategic council and prized wargear to those who shed blood for the Warchief.
As a warrior on the front lines, entry to the Hall of Legends marks the height of martial respect and grants access to the finest wargear the Horde can offer.
